svg.title: ECS task events
svg.desc: A Fargate service whose container always exits with an error makes ECS send Task State Change events. An EventBridge rule matches the tasks that stopped because of an error and sends each event to a log group as is, and to a Lambda function that reads the task definition's tags and logs one slim record.

text.font-family: Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace
